The account and license settings pane: product and tier, the holder, Manage, devices, Cloud Sync status, updates, managed settings and Sign out. A license that is not in an account says so, and offers to add a name and email. The React and web components kits draw it as grouped rows (a label and its value, a switch, the channel as a segmented control), with an Updates heading only when there are update rows, and no placeholder name where the holder is unknown.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `status`; the Textual app's Account page (`polaris_key.ui.terminal.textual_app.run_app(client)`, `[tui]`; [the full-screen app](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-python/#the-full-screen-app)).

    **Styled part.** `screens.gate(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `gate_view("ok", …)` → `GateView(component="AccountAndLicense")` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `status` (`statusFlow`) on a usable license: the tier and who holds it
    (`signed-in`, or `key-only`), how long it works offline, the version and channel. `logout`
    (`logoutFlow`) asks before it signs out; `deactivate` (`deactivateFlow`) releases the license
    on this device. Both take `--yes`.

    **Styled part.** `tableRows` for the aligned rows, and the `promptConfirm` primitive for the
    question.

    **Headless.** `statusView(input)`: AccountAndLicense with `tier`, `holder` and `graceUntil`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Sections a host drops into its own `Form` or `List`: the product row, Manage (external link), Devices, Cloud Sync, Updates and Sign out in its own group, confirmed in the system dialog.

    **Styled part.** `AccountAndLicenseSection(screen:tier:holder:version:devices:autoUpdate:onManage:onSignOut:onCheckNow:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.accountAndLicense(_:)`: with no one signed in it is `key-only`, never another account's holder.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<AccountAndLicense />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<AccountAndLicense />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("AccountAndLicense", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** `PolarisAccount(settings, devices)`: the license, its settings and the devices on one screen.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisAccountScreen`, over the two state holders' `ui` values.

    **Headless.** `PolarisSettingsState` and `PolarisDevicesState` in `polaris-key-ui-core`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
    import androidx.compose.runtime.rememberCoroutineScope
    import im.plrs.key.sdk.PolarisKeyClient
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisAccount
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisDevicesState
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisSettingsState
    import im.plrs.key.ui.devicesActions
    import im.plrs.key.ui.settingsActions

    @Composable
    fun Account(client: PolarisKeyClient) {
        val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
        val settings = remember(client) { PolarisSettingsState(client.settingsActions(), scope) }
        val devices = remember(client) { PolarisDevicesState(client.devicesActions(), scope) }
        PolarisAccount(settings, devices)
    }
    ```

    On Compose Desktop, `PolarisSettingsWindow` shows the Account and Devices panes.

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the Android sample, the theme and the desktop windows.

  </TabItem>
